textbookBox.concept: When triangle ABC fits over triangle XYZ, A lies over X, B over Y and C over Z. These are corresponding vertices.

beats.en: When triangle ABC fits over triangle XYZ, A lies over X, B over Y and C over Z. These are corresponding vertices. Sides AB and XY, BC and YZ, AC and XZ correspond, and so do the angles A and X, B and Y, C and Z.
beats.speakEn: When triangle ABC fits over triangle XYZ, A lies over X, B over Y and C over Z. These are corresponding vertices. Sides AB and XY, BC and YZ, AC and XZ correspond, and so do the angles A and X, B and Y, C and Z.

beats.en: Suppose the angles are 30, 70 and 80 degrees. Many triangles with these angles can be drawn, small and large. They have the same shape but not the same size. So equal angles alone do not make triangles congruent.
